aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP/AD) in Firewall Admin.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure authentication schemes in Barracuda Firewall Admin under Box > Administrative Settings > Access Control.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable HTTP access and restrict SSH access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Configure Box Administration WebAdmin and console SSH parameters in Firewall Admin under Box > Administrative Settings.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Modify session timeout under Box > Administrative Settings > Operational VTY in Firewall Admin.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Barracuda local system passwords are automatically hashed in the internal system database.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Modify SNMP community settings under Box > Infrastructure Services > SNMP Service in Firewall Admin.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable HTTP administrative access in Firewall Admin.
http_server_disabled.notes: Go to Box > Administrative Settings and disable WebAdmin HTTP or redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH configuration is managed under Box > Administrative Settings > Console access in Firewall Admin.

logging_enabled.notes: Go to Box > Infrastructure Services > Syslog Streaming to configure remote syslog destinations.

management_acl.summary: Restrict WebAdmin access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Go to Box > Administrative Settings > Access Control to define Authorized Management IPs.

login_banner.notes: Go to Box > Administrative Settings > custom login message in Firewall Admin.

password_min_length.notes: Configure password complexity rules under Box > Administrative Settings > Password Policy.

ntp_configured.notes: Go to Box > Time Settings to specify time synchronization NTP servers.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only under Box > Infrastructure Services > SNMP Service.
